comment:
Goal 6 on health financing is framed too narrowly. It is currently described mainly in efficiency terms (e.g. claims validation, provider payment, reduced leakages). It omits other important functions of health financing such as revenue raising (e.g. contribution collection, subsidy targeting) and pooling (e.g. budget flows with PFM).  

None of the goals address ageing and long-term care.
